Maharashtra Drought Affects 1.5 Crore Farmers, Government Surveys Talukas

The Maharashtra government is preparing to provide relief to 1.5 crore farmers affected by drought conditions. The administration has declared two additional talukas as drought-hit, bringing the total to 310. Authorities are also planning to survey 11 more talukas to assess the extent of the drought.
